questions.question: What is the main purpose of a rough cut?
choices: Arrange selected clips into an initial version of the story
Add final color grading before footage is chosen
Record a new camera
Create a transcript automatically

questions.question: What is a jump cut?
choices: A camera movement over a hill
An edit that skips part of continuous action, creating a noticeable time jump
A transition that fades to black
A change in audio pitch

questions.question: Why use a continuity edit?
choices: To make every shot the same length
To remove all background sound
To help action and space feel coherent across shots
To add a title to every frame

questions.question: What does a cutaway shot often provide?
choices: A replacement for the entire story
A louder soundtrack
A frame-rate setting
A view of related detail or reaction that can support context or cover an edit

questions.question: Why should dialogue usually be audible above background music?
choices: Viewers need to understand the spoken content
Music must always be silent
Dialogue determines the video resolution
It prevents captions from appearing

questions.question: What is a useful reason to add captions?
choices: They replace visual storytelling
They support access and comprehension, including for viewers who cannot hear the audio
They increase the video's frame rate
They guarantee a factual script

questions.question: What does a timeline track allow an editor to do?
choices: Set a camera's aperture after filming
Choose the original location
Layer and arrange video, audio, titles, or effects over time
Change a subject's identity

questions.question: What is a J-cut?
choices: Video appears before any audio in every clip
A cut shaped like the letter J on screen
An edit that removes all dialogue
Audio from the next shot begins before its video appears

questions.question: A scene feels confusing because the shots change location without clues. What could improve it?
choices: Add an establishing shot or clearer visual and audio continuity
Shorten every shot equally
Increase saturation
Remove all transitions and context

questions.question: Why should an editor organize and label footage?
choices: It improves the camera sensor
It makes clips easier to find and reduces avoidable editing errors
It determines who owns the footage
It guarantees a smooth narrative

questions.question: What should a title card avoid?
choices: Clear contrast
Enough time to read
Text that is too small or displayed too briefly to read
Consistent typography

questions.question: How can an editor improve pacing in an interview video?
choices: Cut every pause regardless of meaning
Use the fastest possible music
Show the same shot throughout
Remove repetition while preserving meaning and natural pauses

questions.question: What does color correction aim to do?
choices: Make footage look consistent and correct unintended color or exposure differences
Add a new plot point
Change the order of dialogue
Set the export file name

questions.question: What is the difference between color correction and a creative grade?
choices: Correction changes audio; grading changes captions
Correction addresses consistency and accuracy; grading shapes a chosen look
They are identical to exporting
Grading is only for black-and-white video

questions.question: Why create a backup of project media?
choices: It guarantees no viewer can copy the video
It increases playback speed
A lost or moved source file can break the edit
It removes the need to save the project

questions.question: What should a creator check before using music in a published video?
choices: Whether the song has a catchy chorus
Whether it is louder than narration
Whether the file name includes a date
Rights, permissions, and any license conditions

questions.question: Which export setting should match the intended viewing platform?
choices: Resolution, aspect ratio, codec, and file-size requirements
The editor's favorite timeline color
The number of project folders
The camera's original battery level

questions.question: A sequence feels too slow. What is a sound editing decision?
choices: Increase all clip volume
Trim redundant moments while keeping the action understandable
Add more unrelated footage
Remove the story's key setup

questions.question: Why review a video after export?
choices: The exported file always matches the timeline perfectly
Playback proves every claim is accurate
Exporting can reveal audio, caption, framing, or encoding problems
Reviewing changes ownership

questions.question: What is a match-on-action edit?
choices: Cutting whenever the music stops
Using the same actor in two scenes
Replacing all movement with a still image
Cutting between shots while an action continues to help the transition feel smooth
